instructions.question: How long will `command` run before it exits on its own?
instructions.focus: Judge the slowest step; a chain of steps runs as long as its slowest one. Use `earlier_runs` when present.

criteria.what: Exits at once, with no noticeable wait: prints, reads or checks something small, or changes a little local state
Takes a few seconds before it exits: a search across many files, a formatter run, a single test file or one network request
Project-scale work that exits after minutes: a full build, a test suite, a lint of the whole project, an install or a large download
Keeps running until someone stops it: a server, watcher, follow mode or interactive program

instructions.question: Does `command` keep running until someone stops it?
instructions.focus: A long build, test run or download still stops on its own.

true.what: A server, watcher, follow mode, REPL or interactive program

false.what: Exits by itself when its work is done, however long that takes
